title: AgentTurnOutput
description: Formal schema for the structured output generated by the agent/model in each dialogue turn.

system_response.description: Conversational text response addressed to the student.

decision_trace.description: Explicit typed trace of procedural and policy decisions made during the turn.

safety_state.description: Updated safety state at the end of the turn.

safety_envelope.description: Formal output of the safety envelope (POL-04 and POL-05), always present.

pol01.description: Optional structured output for policy POL-01 (Implementation Intentions).

pol02.description: Optional structured output for policy POL-02 (Graded Scaffolding).

pol03.description: Optional structured output for policy POL-03 (Accepted Next Action).
